heading: Route size budgets
body:
A release build (`ty bundle`) checks how much script and WebAssembly each route loads. It starts at the page of the route and follows every file that the page loads: script tags, the modules of the services that the view uses, `import`s, `new URL(..., import.meta.url)` and other paths written as text in a script, and the file lists in JSON files that a script reads, such as .NET's `blazor.boot.json`. It does not count the service worker, and it cannot follow a path that a script builds while it runs.

The build writes Tachyon's own page scripts, such as `tac-client.js`, `behavior-runtime.js` and the shared script of each service language (`tachyon-rust.js`, `tachyon-go.js` and the others), without comment lines, indentation or blank lines, so a route carries less of them. The Go glue `wasm_exec.js` is written the same way, and it keeps its license notice. The code in each line stays as written, so an error in the browser still points at readable code.

The sizes are the bytes that Tachyon sends: the Brotli copy when the build wrote one (see Compressed files), else the file itself. The build adds the `.js` and `.mjs` files and the `.wasm` files of each route and stops with `TY1337` when one total is over its budget. The error names the five biggest files, so you know what to split, drop or move to the server. Set the budgets in kilobytes in `client/manifest.json`: `tac.budgets.script` (default 200) and `tac.budgets.webassembly` (default 3584). A route with a Python service gets a script budget of 512 when `tac.python` is set and `tac.budgets.script` is not, because the copied Pyodide runtime brings its own scripts (ADR 0093). `tac.budgets.check: false` turns the check off while a project migrates. `ty preview` does not check budgets, because it sends files without compression while it watches your sources (ADR 0074).

This website uses services in many languages, and the check counts all of them on each route, so its manifest raises the script budget to 320. It loads only the DuVay components that its views use: the full DuVay component bundle is 134 KiB as sent and put the documentation home over that budget.
